name: BACH_0107_FSIM_jpeg3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (75%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
JPEG-degraded simulated frozen section cannot exclude InSitu (24%); defer margins [F7] and review recut/deeper-level orders.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 75%, InSitu 24%, Benign 1%, Normal 0% [F1] | Favors Invasive; InSitu plausible |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% target/coverage, n=132) | Cannot separate InSitu, Invasive |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability, 100% OOD, flagged [F6] | Suspect degraded frozen input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (top class differs) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Invasive (40%), 2/5 InSitu, 1/5 Normal [F5] | Split Invasive vs InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 4, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical (+1.00 contribution; 19/20 AI spot check) [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical (+0.73 contribution; 18/20 AI spot check) [F3] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 3) · context · Below-typical (+0.47 contribution; 8/20 AI spot check) [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Minor (+0.05 contribution; 3/20 AI spot check) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (95% CI 0.002–0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (95% CI -0.009–0.006 includes 0); contrast cites unreliable necrosis (3/20), with negligible mitoses/lobules (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 JPEG degradation on simulated frozen tissue (error AUROC 0.70, ECE 5%) mimics invasion or atypia.
- Lesion is InSitu (24%), matching top neighbors BACH_0155 (79%) and BACH_0241 (77%); cell segmentation disabled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 8, 9, 1, 5**: Verify stromal invasion versus frozen/JPEG artifact; review drafted recut/deeper levels.
2. **Regions 9, 10, 11**: Confirm nuclear pleomorphism on permanent sections and defer margin calls.
3. **Regions 7, 3**: Check duct-confined atypia and normal lobules against InSitu.
